I just got back from my niece's birthday party and I'm still buzzing from the excitement of it all - she's really growing up fast you know? Anyway, I thought you'd like to know that this month's issue is packed with some fantastic stories, including twelve cars to keep an eye on at the upcoming spring auction, a really informative guide to restoring chrome, and some great letters from our readers. If you're not interested anymore, you can always read it online or hit the unsubscribe button. 

Best,
Eleanor
